name: interactive-grid-pattern
title: Interactive Grid Pattern
description: SVG-based grid pattern with interactive rect elements that respond to pointer movement. Each square smoothly fills on hover with a transition delay on exit.
use: An interactive background overlay that responds to mouse movement and engages the user.
avoid: Touch-only devices or keyboard-only navigation: hover is the only interaction method.
a11y: SVG rect elements with pointer events enabled but no keyboard support for individual squares.
